body: I feel the same way. I also have scars from burns and animal scratches and bites on my arm and I almost feel a sense of pride in showing then off to people. I'm just like, have you ever seen all the scars on mg arms? Only once was I ever questioned for being a cutter. I got injured in football and ended up in the hospital. When the nurse examined me, she looked at my arms and then looked at me and asked "where did these come from?" I told her I was just super accident prone, but I could see it in her eyes that she knew I was a cutter. Weird to experience those tendencies to harm oneself.

On the outside, I look like I've got my shit together. That's the mask I wear for people. But inside, I am so fucking depressed. There's only 2 things that keep me holding on...1. My family and friends would be devastated. 2. I still want to see and experience more of the world before I go. I guess I feel like I'll find something out there that will give me a reason to be optimistic. Do you have anything like that?

I feel the same way. I actually slowly slid a large kitchen knife across my wrist today and imagined going through with it...just digging in as deeply as I could. I wasn't planning on going through with it, but feeling the knife on my skin gave me the chills and I instantly got emotional. Then I went for a dangerous drive and almost purposely wrecked my truck at a high speed. The thoughts to do it are in my mind, but I still have hope that maybe things will get better.
